sql:
SELECT
  sitename,
  general_overview ->> 'install_location'     AS install_location,
  general_overview ->> 'operating_status'     AS operating_status,
  general_overview ->> 'supply_population'    AS supply_population,
  service_area,
  general_overview -> 'reservoir_spec' ->> 'facility_capacity_m3' AS facility_capacity,
  general_overview -> 'reservoir_spec' ->> 'count' AS reservoir_count,
  general_overview -> 'reservoir_spec' ->> 'H.W.L' AS hwl,
  general_overview -> 'reservoir_spec' ->> 'L.W.L' AS lwl,
  CASE
    WHEN general_overview ? 'emergency_water_plan'
     AND jsonb_typeof(general_overview -> 'emergency_water_plan') = 'array'
     AND jsonb_array_length(general_overview -> 'emergency_water_plan') > 0
    THEN
      '비상 용수 공급 방안은 '
      || (
        SELECT string_agg(value, ', ')
        FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
          general_overview -> 'emergency_water_plan'
        )
      )
      || ' 입니다.'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS emergency_water_plan_sentence,
  CASE
    WHEN general_overview ? 'water_truck_accessible'
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN general_overview ->> 'water_truck_accessible' = 'true'
        THEN '비상 시 물차 진입이 가능합니다.'
        ELSE '비상 시 물차 진입이 불가능합니다.'
      END
    ELSE NULL
  END AS water_truck_accessible_sentence,
  CASE
    WHEN general_overview ? 'water_truck_turning_possible'
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN general_overview ->> 'water_truck_turning_possible' = 'true'
        THEN '물차 회차가 가능합니다.'
        ELSE '물차 회차가 불가능합니다.'
      END
    ELSE NULL
  END AS water_truck_turning_possible_sentence,
  total_supply_time
FROM v_reservoir_info_status
WHERE sitename = '{sitename}';

sql:
WITH variance AS (
    SELECT
        sitename,
        datainfo,
        variance_status,
        diff_percent
    FROM v_reservoir_status_variance_5min
    WHERE sitename = '{sitename}'
      AND facilitytype = '{facilitytype}'
),
level_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        sitename,
        datainfo,
        ROUND(
            AVG(CASE WHEN bucket_day >= now() - interval '1 month'
                     THEN avg_daily_level END)::numeric, 2
        ) AS avg_month,
        ROUND(
            AVG(CASE WHEN bucket_day >= now() - interval '1 year'
                     THEN avg_daily_level END)::numeric, 2
        ) AS avg_year
    FROM public.mv_reservoir_level_stats_all
    WHERE sitename = '{sitename}'
    GROUP BY sitename, datainfo
),
alarm AS (
    SELECT
        sitename,
        alarm_high_water_level,
        alarm_low_water_level
    FROM v_reservoir_info_status
    WHERE sitename = '{sitename}'
)
SELECT
    v.sitename,
    v.datainfo,
    v.variance_status,
    v.diff_percent,
    a.avg_month,
    a.avg_year,
    al.alarm_high_water_level,
    al.alarm_low_water_level
FROM variance v
LEFT JOIN level_avg a
       ON v.sitename = a.sitename
      AND v.datainfo = a.datainfo
CROSS JOIN alarm al
ORDER BY v.datainfo;

sql:
WITH current_pressure AS (
    SELECT 
        i.sitename,
        i.facilitytype,
        i.datainfo,
        i.unit,
        r.val AS pressure_val,
        r.logtime
    FROM tb_tag_info i
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT val, logtime
        FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
        WHERE r.tagsn = i.tagsn
        ORDER BY r.logtime DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) r ON TRUE
    WHERE i.sitename = '{sitename}'
      AND i.facilitytype = '{facilitytype}'
      AND i.tagtype = 'Analog Input'
      AND i.datainfo ILIKE '%압력%'
),
avg_pressure AS (
    SELECT
        sitename,
        facilitytype,
        datainfo,
        month_avg,
        year_avg,
        unit
    FROM fn_pressure_avg_summary('{sitename}', '{facilitytype}')
)
SELECT
    c.sitename,
    c.facilitytype,
    c.datainfo,
    c.pressure_val,
    to_char(c.logtime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS log_time,
    a.month_avg,
    a.year_avg,
    c.unit
FROM current_pressure c
LEFT JOIN avg_pressure a
  ON c.sitename      = a.sitename
 AND c.facilitytype = a.facilitytype
 AND c.datainfo     = a.datainfo
ORDER BY c.datainfo;

items.text: 전단 가압장 및 감압시설 가동현황을 알려줘
통신 이상 등 데이터 이상여부를 확인해줘

sql:
WITH current_nmf AS (
    SELECT
        log_time,
        sitename,
        facilitytype,
        label,
        datadesc,
        unit,
        val AS current_val
    FROM fn_night_min_flow_summary(
            '{sitename}',
            '{facilitytype}',
            (now() - interval '1 day')::date,
            now()::date
    )
    ORDER BY log_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_nmf AS (
    SELECT
        sitename,
        facilitytype,
        label,
        datadesc,
        unit,
        period_type,
        ROUND(AVG(val), 2) AS avg_val
    FROM (
        SELECT sitename, facilitytype, label, datadesc, unit, val, 'year' AS period_type
        FROM fn_night_min_flow_summary('{sitename}', '{facilitytype}', (now() - interval '1 year')::date, now()::date)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT sitename, facilitytype, label, datadesc, unit, val, 'month' AS period_type
        FROM fn_night_min_flow_summary('{sitename}', '{facilitytype}', (now() - interval '1 month')::date, now()::date)
    ) t
    GROUP BY sitename, facilitytype, label, datadesc, unit, period_type
)
SELECT
    c.sitename,
    c.facilitytype,
    c.label,
    c.datadesc,
    c.current_val,
    c.unit,
    c.log_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.period_type = 'month' THEN a.avg_val END) AS avg_month,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.period_type = 'year'  THEN a.avg_val END) AS avg_year
FROM current_nmf c
LEFT JOIN avg_nmf a
  ON c.sitename = a.sitename
 AND c.facilitytype = a.facilitytype
 AND c.label = a.label
 AND c.datadesc = a.datadesc
GROUP BY c.sitename, c.facilitytype, c.label, c.datadesc, c.current_val, c.unit, c.log_time;

  COUNT(*) AS alarm_count,
  string_agg(DISTINCT alarm_msg, '; ' ORDER BY alarm_msg) AS alarm_msg
FROM tb_equipment_alarm_report
GROUP BY equipment_id, equipmenttype, sitename, facilitytype
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
LIMIT {limit};

  sitename,
  facilitytype,
  COUNT(*) AS alarm_count,
  string_agg(DISTINCT diagnosed_cause, '; ' ORDER BY diagnosed_cause) AS diagnosed_causes
FROM tb_equipment_alarm_report
WHERE diagnosed_cause IS NOT NULL
  AND alarm_msg LIKE '%{alarm_msg}%'
  AND sitename = '{sitename}'
  AND facilitytype = '{facilitytype}'
GROUP BY equipment_id, equipmenttype, sitename, facilitytype
ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
LIMIT {limit};

  to_char(max(r.logtime), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS latest_time
FROM tb_tag_raw_data r
JOIN tb_tag_info i ON r.tagsn = i.tagsn

ORDER BY r.tagsn;

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT result_facilitytype, result_sitename, result_missing_pct
    FROM public.fn_realtime_missing_summary('{sitename}', '{facilitytype}', '{datainfo}')
)
SELECT result_facilitytype AS facilitytype,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN result_missing_pct > 50 THEN 1 END) AS missing_cnt,
       STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN result_missing_pct > 50 THEN result_sitename END, ', ' ORDER BY result_sitename) AS missing_sites
FROM base
GROUP BY result_facilitytype
ORDER BY result_facilitytype;

sql:
SELECT
    m.sitename,
    m.facilitytype,
    fn_night_min_flow_stats('{sitename}', '{facilitytype}') AS stats_report,
    m.avg_val AS avg_month,
    y.avg_val AS avg_year,
    m.unit
FROM (
    SELECT 
        sitename,
        facilitytype,
        ROUND(AVG(val), 2) AS avg_val,
        '㎥/hr' AS unit
    FROM fn_night_min_flow_summary(
        '{sitename}',
        '{facilitytype}',
        date_trunc('month', now())::date,
        now()::date
    )
    GROUP BY sitename, facilitytype
) m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        sitename,
        facilitytype,
        ROUND(AVG(val), 2) AS avg_val
    FROM fn_night_min_flow_summary(
        '{sitename}',
        '{facilitytype}',
        date_trunc('year', now())::date,
        now()::date
    )
    GROUP BY sitename, facilitytype
) y
  ON m.sitename = y.sitename
 AND m.facilitytype = y.facilitytype;
